currentSprint.name: Favorites UX upgrade + cross-locale persistence
currentSprint.progress: Sprint S10 100% completed: Upgraded favorites architecture for seamless cross-locale persistence across EN, ES, and DA. 1) Canonical slug normalization in getCanonicalToolPath strips domains, protocol, query parameters, hash fragments, index.html, and locale prefixes (/es/, /da/), ensuring consistent storage and retrieval keys. 2) getFavoritesList resolves native localized tool names and descriptions via getToolName/getToolDesc, and computes localized target links via localizedPathForLang, ensuring the search modal and homepage quick access cards display localized titles and links for Spanish and Danish users. 3) Extended initToolPageActions layout detection to .dc-root and breadcrumb selector to nav[aria-label='Breadcrumb'], mounting tool actions universally on document converter pages. 4) Added accessible ARIA semantics: aria-pressed='true|false' on toggle button, aria-keyshortcuts='Alt+F', and updated tooltip titles. 5) Added high-contrast :focus-visible CSS rules for .tool-page-action-btn:focus-visible and .dash-quick-card:focus-visible (2px solid #B04A45 with 2px offset). 6) Added document-level Alt+F hotkey listener for instant favorite toggling. 7) Verified canonical favorite_added and favorite_removed analytics event emission via window.ACAnalytics. Built tests/test_s10_favorites_ux.js (12/12 passing). All 25 master test suites passed (25/25 PASS, 100%). Pre-deploy release gate report G1-G15 recorded in docs/growth/91-TEST-EVIDENCE-AND-RELEASE-GATES.md and ADR-049 recorded in .ai-memory/DECISIONS.md.
